description: Update a forum post's title, archived/locked state, or applied tags. Only provided fields change; passing applied_tags replaces the post's tags. Set archived:true to close a post without deleting it. Requires the Manage Threads permission.

applied_tags.description: Tag IDs to apply; replaces the post's current tags. Get valid IDs from discord_get_forum_tags.

archived.description: true to archive (close) the post, false to reopen it.

locked.description: true to lock the post so only moderators can reply.

thread_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the forum post (thread) to update.

name: discord_update_forum_post
